queries.query: I need a 3-bedroom, 2-bath in Northwest Crossing
queries.why: Cite the community page: indexable Place JSON-LD and its live inventory. AEO-2 (2026-09-22): /homes-for-sale/bend/northwest-crossing, with or without ?beds=3&baths=2, is a key in data/legacy-redirects.json since SITE-171 (e952d8492), and middleware 301s it to the community page and drops the filter, so neither URL is citable. Faceted search stays noindex by design (shouldNoIndexSearchVariant).
